name: Kisaragi Midori
source:
As eldest daughter of the three Kisaragi sisters Midori has a warm and gentle personality. Midori  currently studies at a university, but continues to work part-time as a shrine maiden while helping her family with household chores.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3378]Getchu[/url].]
